text:
Centre-left: a conical-bottom centrifuge tube held upright in a black bracket/clamp mounted on a black carbon-fibre-panelled vertical frame. The tube has an orange screw cap, capped and in place, and contains a red-pink liquid filling most of the tube body, with a clear/empty region near the neck. Directly above the tube is a dark red-brown cylindrical component attached to a white 3D-printed housing at the top of the frame.

Right of centre: a grey/silver cylindrical camera or sensor on a bracket, with black cables running from it, in front of a green panel. Below and right: black anodised metal stages, plates and a gripper-like mechanism with screws and connectors. Black cables lie on the white benchtop at bottom right.
